description: Header file defining utility functions for converting between Skia graphics types and macOS CoreGraphics types, as well as color conversions involving NSColor, CGColorRef, and SkColor.

classes.name: NSBitmapImageRep
classes.description: Objective-C class for bitmap image representation in macOS.

classes.name: NSImage
classes.description: Objective-C class for image objects in macOS.

classes.name: NSImageRep
classes.description: Objective-C class for image representation in macOS.

classes.name: NSColor
classes.description: Objective-C class for color objects in macOS.

methods.name: SkMatrixToCGAffineTransform
methods.description: Converts a Skia SkMatrix to a CoreGraphics CGAffineTransform.

methods.name: CGRectToSkRect
methods.description: Converts a CGRect to a Skia SkRect.

methods.name: SkIRectToCGRect
methods.description: Converts a Skia SkIRect to a CGRect.

methods.name: SkRectToCGRect
methods.description: Converts a Skia SkRect to a CGRect.

methods.name: NSSystemColorToSkColor
methods.description: Converts an NSColor representing a system color to a SkColor.

methods.name: CGColorRefToSkColor
methods.description: Converts a CGColorRef to a SkColor in sRGB color space.

methods.name: CGColorCreateFromSkColor
methods.description: Creates a CGColorRef from a SkColor, assuming sRGB color space.

methods.name: NSDeviceColorToSkColor
methods.description: Converts an NSColor in device or calibrated space to a SkColor.

methods.name: SkColorToCalibratedNSColor
methods.description: Converts a SkColor to an NSColor in calibrated color space.

methods.name: SkColorToDeviceNSColor
methods.description: Converts a SkColor to an NSColor in device color space.

methods.name: SkColorToSRGBNSColor
methods.description: Converts a SkColor to an NSColor in sRGB color space.

methods.name: CGImageToSkBitmap
methods.description: Converts a CGImageRef to a Skia SkBitmap.

methods.name: NSImageToSkBitmapWithColorSpace
methods.description: Draws an NSImage into a SkBitmap with specified color space.

methods.name: NSImageRepToSkBitmapWithColorSpace
methods.description: Draws an NSImageRep into a SkBitmap with specified size and color space.

methods.name: SkBitmapToNSBitmapImageRepWithColorSpace
methods.description: Converts a SkBitmap to an NSBitmapImageRep with specified color space.

methods.name: SkBitmapToNSImageWithColorSpace
methods.description: Converts a SkBitmap to an NSImage with specified color space.
